Image generation returning base64-encoded data instead of URL

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using LiterLlm;

var apiKey = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("API_KEY") ??
  throw new InvalidOperationException("API_KEY must be set");

var result = await client.ImageGenerateAsync(new CreateImageRequest { Model = "dall-e-3", N = 1, Prompt = "A blue circle", ResponseFormat = "b64_json", Size = "1024x1024" });
```
